title: Verification: Add tests & smoke checks for IsLoopback change
description:
Add unit and integration tests to validate null-IPAddress behavior and ForwardedHeaders guidance. Include a simple smoke test that simulates reverse-proxy null RemoteIpAddress and confirms middleware denies non-loopback calls.

Acceptance criteria:
- Unit tests for `IsLoopback` handling null and mapped IPv6
- Integration test for middleware path showing 403 when RemoteIpAddress is null and AllowRemoteApi=false
- Document test results in task comment

Effort: 3-4h
